gloss: during a journey; on the way; travels

definitions.gloss: during a journey; on the way; travels
definitions.explanation: The time or experience during a trip or journey. Can refer to the journey itself or events that happen along the way.

examples.japanese: {道中|どうちゅう}お{気|き}をつけて。
{道中|どうちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found an interesting shop along the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{道中|どうちゅう}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was a long journey, but we managed to arrive safely at our destination.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during, in the middle of). Historically associated with travel along the main highways of Edo-period Japan, as in {東海道中|とうかいどうちゅう} (journey along the Tokaido road).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道中|どうちゅう}お{気|き}をつけて (take care on your journey — a standard farewell)
- {道中|どうちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (during the journey, on the way)
- {珍|ちん}{道中|どうちゅう} (comic journey, misadventure trip)
- {道中|どうちゅう}{記|き} (travel journal)

The expression {道中|どうちゅう}お{気|き}をつけて is a polite way to wish someone a safe trip. The word has a slightly literary or traditional feel compared to ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ (on the way), which is more neutral and everyday.
